summary: Established architecture-contract-first TDD as the default executable delivery policy, with strict RED-GREEN-REFACTOR repair behavior and proportionate exceptions for documentation, bounded exploration, and non-automatable live boundaries.
steps: Converted the repository repair rule from reproduce-then-test to an explicit contract, RED, GREEN, REFACTOR, and full-gate sequence.
Defined RED validity, successor-RED handling after semantic review findings, and strict separation between test-only and production-write assignments.
Defined feature delivery as a thin observable acceptance example followed by TDD once executable, without forcing ceremonial tests on documentation or live-only evidence.
Mirrored the authoritative English policy in the Chinese repair guide and linked the compact rule from AGENTS.md.
Updated the reusable agile-delivery skill core, initialization guidance, delivery flow, and multi-agent handoff rules to generate the same behavior for future projects.

evidence.note: Skill folder passed required frontmatter and naming validation after the TDD update.

evidence.target: git diff --check for project and skill repositories
evidence.note: No whitespace errors were reported; only informational Windows line-ending notices appeared.
The existing 30 development-memory records validated before adding this task stream.

limitations: This policy change does not itself prove a product Issue or clean-Profile behavior; each executable slice still needs its own RED, GREEN, full gate, independent review, integration read-back, and required live evidence.
